en: A black‑and‑white aerial view of a European town with dense, tiled rooftops, several church towers, and a large central building. In the foreground and midground are multi‑storey 19th‑century style townhouses and civic buildings. A church with large Gothic-style windows and another tall tower dominate the skyline. There are visible commercial signs on some buildings. The scene looks out toward open countryside in the far distance. The lower-left corner bears a printed caption and a building sign near the bottom right advertises a local newspaper.
